metadata.description: Azure region.
Container app name.
Resource ID of the VNet-injected Container Apps managed environment.
Fully qualified image reference, e.g. <acr>.azurecr.io/storage-proxy:v2. When `containerAppExists` is true and a live image is present, the existing image wins (azd-style image preservation).
When true, the module reads the live container app image and preserves it across redeploys. Set this to the value of azd's SERVICE_STORAGE_PROXY_RESOURCE_EXISTS environment variable.
Resource ID of the storage-proxy UAMI.
clientId of the UAMI — surfaced as AZURE_CLIENT_ID.
principalId of the UAMI — used for Storage role assignment.
Resource ID of the Azure Container Registry hosting the image. Used for managed-identity ACR pull.
Optional explicit ACR login server (e.g. cronlgvc76rbuge.azurecr.io). When empty, derived from acrResourceId.
Name of the storage account the proxy talks to. Surfaced as AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME.
Ingress target port.
Container CPU.
Container memory.
Minimum replicas.
Maximum replicas.
Tag map applied to the container app.

When true, this module creates an AcrPull role assignment scoped to the current RG. Leave false when the ACR lives in a different RG/subscription and RBAC is granted out-of-band on the ACR scope. Live deployment grants AcrPull directly on the ACR resource in rg-hiacoo-mcp-private.
Azure region for the eval-service stack.
Resource ID of the subnet that will host the Cosmos DB private endpoint. Network policies must be disabled on this subnet.
Resource ID of the privatelink.documents.azure.com private DNS zone that is already vnet-linked.
Resource ID of the existing user-assigned managed identity granted Cosmos DB data plane access.
clientId of the user-assigned managed identity — surfaced as AZURE_CLIENT_ID inside the container.
Resource ID of an existing Container Apps managed environment with VNet injection.

Fully qualified image reference for the eval-service container, e.g. <acr>.azurecr.io/eval-service/eval-service:v26. When `containerAppExists` is true and a live image is present, the existing image wins (azd-style image preservation).
When true, the module reads the live container app image and preserves it across redeploys. Set this to the value of azd's SERVICE_EVAL_SERVICE_RESOURCE_EXISTS environment variable.
Resource ID of the Azure Container Registry that hosts the image. Used for managed-identity ACR pull RBAC.
Optional explicit ACR login server (e.g. <acr>.azurecr.io). When empty, derived from acrResourceId.

When true, this module creates an AcrPull role assignment at the current RG scope. Leave false when the ACR lives in another RG/subscription and AcrPull is granted out-of-band on the ACR scope. The iqpoc deployment grants AcrPull directly on the ACR in rg-hiacoo-mcp-private.
Foundry project endpoint passed as FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT.
Model deployment used by default evaluations.
Application Insights connection string for OpenTelemetry export. Empty disables telemetry.
Cosmos DB account name (3-44 lowercase chars + digits + dashes).
Private endpoint name for the Cosmos account. Leave empty to auto-derive pe-<cosmosAccountName>.
Cosmos database name.
Container App name.
Background poller interval in seconds (0 disables when EVAL_POLLER_DISABLED=1).
